svg.aria-label: Sensitivity of exact cancellation. The plant dx/dt = (1 + eps)x squared + u with the linearizing control u = −x squared − x designed for eps = 0 gives dx/dt = eps x squared − x. With eps = 0.1, starts below 1/eps = 10 (here 3 and 9) converge to zero, but a start at x = 11 escapes to infinity at t = ln 11 ≈ 2.4
